visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white oversized t-shirt and blue jeans, stands in a modern kitchen and dining area. She speaks animatedly with her hands, smiling at the camera. The background shows a wooden dining table, a white pendant light, and kitchen cabinetry. (2) The scene cuts to her walking towards the dining table. She points towards a long wooden dining chair with a green quilted cushion. (3) She sits down on the green cushioned bench, continuing her enthusiastic narration. The table is set with items like tissues, a bottle of water, and some yellow cups. (4) The camera focuses on her upper body as she explains the features of the furniture, touching her hair and gesturing frequently. (5) A close-up shot follows, showing her hands pressing into the green quilted cushion of the bench to demonstrate its texture and firmness. (6) She stands up again, leaning over the table and gesturing towards the living space behind her while speaking. (7) The scene transitions to a bedroom setting. She jumps playfully onto a bed that has two green character-themed plush pillows. (8) She leans on the bed, pointing towards the mattress which has a distinct white and grey checkered top surface. (9) She sits on the edge of the mattress, pressing her hands down to show the support and firmness of the product while looking at the camera with a smile. (10) She crawls towards the edge of the bed, interacting with someone off-camera, laughing and gesturing before the video ends.
